note: Lean takes a real spatial cutoff `g` constant near the distinguished point and a profile `f` with the `Jury` support condition instead of a general real c(y)h(t-t0); the Cauchy limits on each side are in `tidal_limit`, and the jump is the boundary version at ordered heights tending to zero.

theorem verdict (K : Killing) (T : S.Stress) (v : Fin n → S.Tag) (k : Fin (n+1)) (B : S.Tag)
    (R : S.Rotation) (w : Prospect F Z U P H T) (h : StressLaws U T P.deriv R.lie) (M : Joint (n+1)) (hM : HasCompactSupport ⇑M)
    (g : Probe Space3) (hg : HasCompactSupport ⇑g) (hr : ∀ r, ((g r).re:ℂ)=g r) (f : Probe ℝ) (hf : HasCompactSupport ⇑f)
    (ha : Gallery W Z) (hk : ∀ x∈tsupport M, Jury g f (x k)) :
    let A := Bid.ink (hole k v B)
    stamp W K T A k.succ M g f-stamp W K T A k.castSucc M g f=receives W K R P v k B M * ∫ x, f x := by

proof_context.conclusion: `verdict` says that for a spatial cutoff `g` equal to 1 near the point and a unit-integral time profile `f`, the stress-inserted boundary quantity `stamp` changes across the distinguished slot by `receives * ∫ f`, where `receives` is the rank action plus the derivative terms.
